comment: The country the store ships from, used as the origin for shipping-rate calculation.
modal: The country of the store's shipping origin. Carriers use it as the starting point when calculating shipping rates and estimating delivery. Can be set per website.

comment: The state or region the store ships from.
modal: The region or state of the store's shipping origin, paired with the origin country for rate calculation. Can be set per website.

comment: The ZIP or postal code the store ships from.
modal: The postal code of the store's shipping origin, used by carriers to calculate shipping rates. Can be set per website.

comment: The city the store ships from.
modal: The city of the store's shipping origin address. Can be set per website.

comment: The street address the store ships from.
modal: The street address of the store's shipping origin. Can be set per website.

comment: The second line of the store's shipping origin street address.
modal: An optional second line for the shipping origin street address. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether a custom shipping policy is shown to customers at checkout.
modal: When **Yes**, the custom shipping policy text is displayed to customers during checkout. Set to **No** to hide it. Can be set per website.

comment: The custom shipping policy text shown to customers.
modal: The shipping policy wording displayed at checkout. Applies only when **Apply custom Shipping Policy** is set to Yes. Can differ per website or store view.
